indicator_name: Kazakhstan's imports by partner country (UN Comtrade): consumer goods by BEC and all goods
description: Импорт Казахстана по странам-партнёрам (UN Comtrade): потребительские товары по BEC и все товары
methodology: Item BASKET.M49 partner code (0 = World). CONSUMER = BEC rev.4 112+122+522+61+62+63 (household food and drink, passenger cars, durable/semi-durable/non-durable consumer goods); TOTAL = all goods (HS TOTAL). Reported by Kazakhstan: EAEU partners by survey, China under-recorded against the mirror, partner attribution shifts in 2020-2022. From 1995, Kazakhstan's first year in Comtrade (1995-2009 added 2026-09-28 for the NEER history). CONSUMER is not comparable over 2000: 1995-1999 are reported in HS1992 (H0), whose BEC conversion puts passenger cars in 522 (1999: 223 of 661 mln USD, 156 from Russia), H1 from 2000 puts them in 51 (522 = 5-50 mln); and 2000 itself converts almost nothing (36 mln USD against 661 in 1999 and 775 in 2001; TOTAL is complete) -- NEER_IMPORT_WEIGHTED does not use CONSUMER 2000. The last three years are re-read on each refresh.
